title: Entitled Teen Girl Loses It When Finally Told 'No'
description:
On May 30th, 2022, An officer was dispatched in regards to a minor attempting to run away from her juvenile centre, and assaulting its staff members. Soon, the juvenile was taken into care by the paramedics. She was charged with aggravated assault and resisting. YouTube thinks you'll love the video on screen, click to watch now.
